audit_status: AUDIT COMPLETE — owner-approved functional baseline and source/synthetic scope
reference_status: Owner explicitly waived a reference for A115: "115 no refrence do as u find suitable". No additional A115 reference is required. This supersedes the previous A114 next-page reference gate.

criteria: Show filename, import type and row counts by planned create/update/skip/error action.
Show parsed business values and readable resolved targets; explain planned changes before confirmation.
Surface row errors and a way to correct/re-upload without silently reusing an older plan.
Keep create-only versus update-existing intent explicit and consistent across Web/native.
Bind confirmation to the exact validated preview/intent, recheck current company/branch permissions and reference state, and execute once.
Show actual committed created/updated/skipped results and safe failure/loading states. Opening-balance groups require explicit consistent accounting context.
owner_approved_design_basis.implementation_authorization: This turn continues the numbered audit and establishes the expected A115 behavior. It does not execute an import or deploy a redesign.

findings.current_behavior: Execution reads READY metadata before the transaction and updates PROCESSING by ID without an atomic ready-state claim/recheck. Two calls can both retain the earlier READY snapshot and repeat non-financial master creates even when their transaction bodies run sequentially.
findings.required_correction: Atomically claim/recheck the job under a lock or conditional state transition inside the transaction, bind the immutable plan and preserve replay-safe completed outcomes. Test real overlapping requests, including creates without unique codes/phones.
findings.evidence: Actual execute helper called twice against two READY snapshots with serialized mocked transaction bodies invoked customer.create twice and returned two non-idempotent results. Real PostgreSQL concurrency was not executed. Existing opening-journal idempotency is not asserted broken.

findings.classification: Persisted preview execution lacks current branch/reference revalidation
findings.current_behavior: Job lookup and target updates are company-scoped, but execution trusts persisted resolved IDs/branch IDs without checking the confirming actor's current selected branches or revalidating active units/categories/targets. Mobile detail also returns company-scoped job metadata without branch filtering.
findings.required_correction: Reauthorize the whole stored plan for the current actor, including source/target branch eligibility, active references and changed targets. Keep intended shared-company review access explicit; creator-only access is not assumed. Add negative branch, role-change and stale-reference tests.
findings.evidence: Actual execute helper with a SELECTED_BRANCHES actor restricted to branch-a invoked a mocked customer.create for persisted branch-b. Its job filter contained only id/companyId. No real unauthorized branch write or production disclosure was performed.

findings.classification: File-only job identity can retain a different update plan
findings.current_behavior: Preview storage keys only company/type/fileHash and uses update:{}. Re-uploading identical bytes with updateExisting false after a prior true preview returns the old job while mobile returns the newly computed preview alongside it. Confirmation can execute the persisted UPDATE plan despite the latest displayed SKIP plan.
findings.required_correction: Version/bind preview identity to explicit intent and relevant validation context. Return the authoritative stored plan on every platform. Preserve completed import history rather than overwriting it blindly; ensure a changed-intent preview cannot execute an older plan.
findings.evidence: Actual parser/preview/save/execute probes produced UPDATE then SKIP for the same bytes; the emulated upsert retained UPDATE and actual execute invoked a mocked product update. No real product was changed.

findings.classification: Opening-balance rows can lose their accounting context
findings.current_behavior: Preview validates individual row dates/financial years/branches and only checks an overall debit/credit total. Execution posts all rows in one journal using the first row's year, branch and effective date. Rows for other contexts lose their specified context.
findings.required_correction: Require a uniform journal context per opening-balance job or explicitly partition independently balanced and authorized groups. Revalidate every group at confirmation; show each context in the preview. Do not move entries across periods or branches.
findings.evidence: Actual preview accepted a balanced two-row fixture for branch-a/FY-A and branch-b/FY-B. Actual execute constructed one mocked posting call with both lines under branch-a/FY-A. postJournalInTx was mocked; no real journal was posted.

findings.classification: Confirmation lacks a readable change preview and result summary
findings.current_behavior: Web preview renders row number, action and messages, omitting row business values and resolved targets. Native renders raw JSON instead of a typed business preview. Web result state shows status/valid counts rather than committed create/update/skip counts. Confirmation visibility is based mainly on invalidCount/status rather than explicit current capabilities.
findings.required_correction: Implement the owner-approved readable preview criteria, including planned values/target context and suitable before/after details for updates, explicit authorized confirmation and actual result counts. Provide safe retry/correction, pending and error states.
findings.evidence: Actual Web SSR showed Row 2/UPDATE but omitted synthetic item name/code/target. Native JsonList preview falls back to item.toString() by source review; physical-device readability and accessibility were not tested.

findings.classification: Update counters ignore affected row counts
findings.current_behavior: Customer/vendor/product updateMany calls are followed by updated++ regardless of the returned count. A disappeared or unmatched target can yield COMPLETED and updated:1 despite zero rows being changed.
findings.required_correction: Use actual affected counts and treat stale/missing targets as an explicit conflict/skip according to the approved plan. Never report a successful update when no row was affected; keep transaction/job outcomes consistent.
findings.evidence: Actual execute helper with mocked product.updateMany count:0 returned status COMPLETED, updated:1.

verified_existing_controls: Master preview parsing is read-only: the synthetic valid-item preview invoked no master create/update or job-save operation.
An already-COMPLETED sequential replay returned idempotent:true without master writes. This does not establish concurrent safety.
Persisted blocking row errors were rejected before master writes.
Opening-balance execution rejected a non-admin and did not invoke the posting service.
related_findings: A116-F04 covers shallow numeric/intra-file validation that affects whether previews can be trusted.
A113-F03 covers current export files missing required import columns.

verification.scope: 15 audit probes call actual import parser/preview/save/execute services or actual page SSR with mocked database, posting and transaction boundaries. 18 existing parser/menu/native-boundary checks also passed. No actual user file, real import, real ledger posting, live HTTP server or physical device execution. Serialized mock transactions do not certify a real database race.

implementation_changes: NONE — audit findings and chosen expected design only; no imports or application fixes were run.
